Amazon Prime Air is the company's drone delivery service, and today announced a major expansion of its service area. By the end of 2026, it is expected to cover nearly 500 US cities. Below are the areas where Amazon drone delivery will be launched next.

Amazon Prime Air will cover nearly 500 US cities by the end of 2026

Amazon's Prime Air service is expanding rapidly, with plans to cover nearly 500 cities and towns across the US by the end of 2026—six times its current coverage area—bringing ultra-fast drone delivery to communities serving tens of millions of customers nationwide. Prime Air offers the largest selection of drone-deliverable items, including millions of groceries, electronics, cosmetics, medications and household essentials, with everyday low prices and delivery in as little as 30 minutes.

Prime Air currently covers the following areas:

  • Tolleson, Arizona (Phoenix metro area)
  • Luskint, Florida (Tampa metro area)
  • Kansas City, Kansas
  • Papillion, Nebraska (Omaha metro area)
  • Baton Rouge, Louisiana
  • Hazel Park, Michigan (Detroit metro area)
  • Pontiac, Michigan (Detroit metro area)
  • Richmond, Texas (Houston metro area)
  • San Antonio, Texas
  • Richardson, Texas (Dallas metro area)
  • Waco, Texas

Drone delivery will be rolling out in the following metro areas: Chicago, Illinois; Syracuse, New York; Cleveland, Ohio; Atlanta, Georgia; and Boise, Idaho. Amazon added that "more communities will be added later."

Prime members get free drone delivery on orders of $50 or more. Orders under $50 incur a $2.99 delivery fee, while non-Prime members can use drone delivery for $4.99.

Is Amazon drone delivery available in your area? What do you think of using it? Feel free to share your experience in the comments.
